name: Bibi Beep World
summary: Bibi Beep World is a life simulation and sandbox game for young children with no goals, scores or time limits. Players move characters around a five-room house and a map of ten regions with 51 locations - including a farm, a circus, a ski lodge, a beach, a hair salon and an amusement park - and play by dragging, tapping and combining objects. 48 locations have a short touch-based story and three hidden stars. The game also includes a home designer and a character creator, plays offline and has a picture-based interface with text in 20 languages.
